Our claude tells us that its more likely a CL bug tho. have put too much faith in lodekeeper its was 40C+ here today sunny for sure, but not nice Not sure if part of the issue or fallout from it: Some nodes received the payload for slot 13961 without a BAL (empty byte list). That triggered the BAL mismatches and is probably the reason for the 13961 payload getting orphaned. It's mainly visible on prysm nodes, who sent the engine_newPayload with empty BAL via the engine API to ELs which rejected them (see engine snooper logs) ``` $ panda auth login Error: login failed: discovering OIDC config: discovering auth metadata failed: /.well-known/openid-configuration: discovery endpoint returned status 503: 503 Service Temporarily Unavailable

``` is panda down or is that just me? <@84562395988508672> aussies probably assume all are asleep up here and probably rolling an update 🤣 I do not assume sunny=nice for years now

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
Not sure if part of the issue or fallout from it:
Some nodes received the payload for slot 13961 without a BAL (empty byte list).
That triggered the BAL mismatches and is probably the reason for the 13961 payload getting orphaned.
It's mainly visible on prysm nodes, who sent the engine_newPayload with empty BAL via the engine API to ELs  which rejected them (see engine snooper logs)
